## Objective

Describe what needs to be tested or validated.

## Questions to answer

- Does it work with the current architecture?
- Is the documentation sufficient?
- Is it easy to integrate and maintain?
- What are the main advantages and limitations?

## Tasks

- [ ] Create the POC
- [ ] Test the integration
- [ ] Document the results

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The POC can be reproduced
- [ ] The result is documented
- [ ] A clear conclusion can be added to the technology decision matrix
